text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant="CerebroPay" cluster="ded-cc-7" reason="p99_latency>2000ms and 503_rate>5%" -- policy=reserved-capacity-latency

pagerduty-bot: page triggered -> INC-47219, severity=high, routed to @oncall

Alex (oncall): acked. looking.

Alex (oncall): quick ask — is this across the whole tenant or one pool?

Lee (sre): initial glance: reserved pool `rp-7` shows sustained CPU spikes + kvcache evictions. p99 up across two nodes.

Priya (eng-ops): I see autoscaler error in logs, failing to attach burst GPUs: `AttachCapacityError: quota exceeded`

Jordan (infra): copying relevant logs —
```
2026-03-15T04:02:11Z ERROR autoscaler: attach failed: quota limit
2026-03-15T04:02:14Z WARN  routing: fallback attempts=3 -> hit serving-503
2026-03-15T04:02:20Z INFO  kvcache: evicted 18 prefixes
```

Alex (oncall): @Priya can you confirm quota? if quota blocked, we need an emergency bump or immediate routing change.

Priya (eng-ops): raised cloud quota request to infra team 2m ago. cloud console shows "limit reached" for vGPU-family-a. Bumping will take ~8-12m for approval.

Sam (pm): customer impact — CerebroPay reports payment verification delays. CS says ~12% of requests failing (from their monitoring). Please keep me posted, will inform customer if ETA > 10m.

Lee (sre): mitigation path A: evacuate traffic off rp-7 to rp-3 (compatible model variant) -> quick route change, minimal config. Path B: force-scale reserved (if quota OK). Trying A now.

Alex (oncall): do path A. post the command.

Lee (sre): executing route override ->
```
redwoodctl route override --tenant cerebropay --from-reserved rp-7 --to-reserved rp-3 --ttl 600
```

pagerduty-bot: INC-47219 acknowledged by Alex (oncall) at 04:03:02Z

Priya (eng-ops): override accepted by router, traffic shifting. current split: 80%->rp-3, 20%->rp-7.

Jordan (infra): monitoring metrics... p99 dropping from ~2.4s -> 1.1s on rp-3 but 503s still at 4% overall.

Alex (oncall): good. keep watch for error rate on rp-3 (compatibility). any regressions rollback.

Customer Support: FYI — CerebroPay CS says volume spike correlates with campaign rollout, might stay high for ~30m.

Sam (pm): noted. if spike continues we might need to open temporary dedicated burst for them.

Lee (sre): noticing kvcache warm-up on rp-3, some tail latency. pushing cache pre-pop via warmup job:
```
redwoodctl warmup --tenant cerebropay --targets rp-3 --prompts-file /tmp/cerebro_hot_prompts.txt
```

Priya (eng-ops): cloud quota update: approval still pending. request ID 8c9f. If approval delayed, we should plan fallback to hosted model variant (lower-cost model) for some fraction.

Alex (oncall): agree. plan B ready: split 30% -> hosted-small, 70% -> rp-3. We prefer not to send production PII to hosted, check with Sam/CS.

Sam (pm): CerebroPay contract allows fallback to hosted only for < 15% of traffic without new data residency consents. need to keep hosted usage <15%.

Lee (sre): adjusting plan: 10% -> hosted-small, 90% -> rp-3. executing.

Lee (sre): `redwoodctl route override --tenant cerebropay --to-hosted hosted-small --percent 10` -> applied.

Jordan (infra): metrics update @04:08:00Z: overall 503_rate down to 1.2%, p99 ~900ms. good trend.

Alex (oncall): Pete? (senior) — not required yet, but tagging for visibility. @Jordan continues infra ops.

pagerduty-bot: INC-47219 escalated to SRE lead (if not ack in 10m)

Priya (eng-ops): quota finally approved! cloud bump applied at 04:09:45Z. starting attach to add 2 vGPUs to rp-7.

Lee (sre): if attach succeeds we can move traffic back. trying attach command now: `cloudctl attach vgpu --pool rp-7 --count 2`

Jordan (infra): attach succeeded at 04:11:10Z. rp-7 capacity increased.

Alex (oncall): rolling back overrides, moving traffic gradually back to rp-7 (health checks first).

Lee (sre): rollback cmd:
```
redwoodctl route revert --tenant cerebropay --from-hosted hosted-small --from-reserved rp-3 --to-reserved rp-7 --gradual 60
```

Priya (eng-ops): revert acknowledged, 20% moved per 15s.

Jordan (infra): monitoring: p99 stable ~600ms, 503_rate <0.5%, kvcache fill complete.

Alex (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. will keep thread ~30m for postmortem notes.

Customer Support: informed CerebroPay that issue mitigated and we are monitoring. they appreciate the fast response.

Sam (pm): quick customer impact note for postmortem: ~12% requests impacted for ~9 minutes peak, partial fallback to hosted for 10% traffic for ~7 minutes.

Alex (oncall): INC-47219 -> resolved at 04:15:23Z (mitigated). leaving open for PM/sre to add RCA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: auto-close timer set for 30m, please file postmortem if >1% revenue impact.

Priya (eng-ops): filing follow-up ticket to refine autoscaler quota checks and add pre-approval for burst windows.

Lee (sre): will add kvcache warmup as a blue-green step for reserved pool swaps.

Sam (pm): I'll coordinate customer comms and draft an incident summary.

Alex (oncall): thanks team. switching to monitoring-only. :thumbsup:
